name: increment_strong_count_in
declaration: unsafe fn increment_strong_count_in (ptr : * const T , alloc : A) where A : Clone ,
rules: The pointer must have been obtained through Arc::into_raw.
The pointer must satisfy the layout requirements specified in Arc::from_raw_in.
The associated Arc instance must be valid, with a strong count of at least 1, for the duration of this method.
The pointer must point to a block of memory allocated by alloc.
